name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Hold the bell by the handle with both hands in front of your thighs, knees unlocked
Push your hips back and keep the bell close to your legs
Lower until your hamstrings stretch while your back stays long
Squeeze your glutes to bring your hips through
